_note: SAMPLE. A fictional insurer and plan for the demo. Quotes are checked against the plan document's own text (sample-health-plan-2026.pdf).
title: Sample Health Plan Summary Plan Description, plan year 2026 (SAMPLE)

P31.say: This claim is part of my hospital stay for the birth of my child.
Please check my stay against this rule before asking for prior authorization.
If prior authorization could not be obtained in time, the plan does not allow a denial for that reason alone.

M12.say: This claim is part of my hospital stay for the birth of my child.

N05.say: This care was for my newborn child during my hospital stay.

childbirth-covered.quote: Medically necessary inpatient care for childbirth and delivery is covered.

newborn-covered.quote: Care for a newborn child during the mother's covered inpatient stay is covered.

no-auth-for-childbirth-stay.quote: Prior authorization is not required for a hospital stay for childbirth of up to 48 hours after a vaginal delivery or 96 hours after a cesarean section.

emergency-auth.quote: In emergency situations or when prior authorization cannot be obtained, covered services will not be denied solely for lack of prior authorization.

code-p31.quote: P31 Prior authorization was not obtained for this service.

code-m12.quote: M12 This service was not found to be medically necessary.

code-n05.quote: N05 The patient was not enrolled in the plan on the date of service.

appeal-180-days.quote: You may file an appeal within 180 days after you receive notice of a denial.

appeal-address.quote: Send your appeal in writing to: Appeals Department, Sample Health Plan, PO Box 12345, Riverton, ST 12345.

appeal-contents.quote: Include your name, member ID, claim number, and the reason you disagree. You may include documents, records and written comments.

copies-free.quote: You may ask for free copies of all documents, records and other information relevant to your claim.

decide-60-days.quote: We will decide an appeal about care you already received within 60 days after we receive it.

external-review.quote: If we uphold the denial, our letter will explain your right to an external review by an independent reviewer.

_grounds_note: 'say' never states a fact about the family that is not in the case; 'needs: birth' means the case must show a birth (a newborn in the household or the 'birth' context chip).
